integrity_statement: The signed-walk normal form, rotation obstruction, reflection-count recurrence, orbit-size formula and asymptotic are proved in RESULT.md; exact enumerations in check_cycle_units.py are corroborative, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: All-length proof only for strict graph endomorphism monoids of simple cycles on at least four vertices. No weak maps, image-rank-refined conjugacy, or independent validation. The full 2009 Michels–Knauer article could not be inspected; historical priority is conditional.
title: Full unit-conjugacy orbit-size spectrum of finite cycle-graph endomorphisms
